restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes, each two independent uniform 256-bit words, little-endian.
One batch of 2^129 samples. Repeated messages are not treated as collisions. No restart.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256, 2 prefix rounds, one 64-byte root block, flags 11, length 64, counter 0.
Classical 256-bit word RAM. Full 256-bit digest comparison. No truncated key and no heuristic.
Worst-case merge-sort envelope. The bound holds for every function from the message domain to 256-bit strings.
